in_marathi.name: Jananiyaa
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Mother of the Universe
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jananiyaa हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jananiyaa is a Sanskrit name derived from the word Janani, which means mother. The suffix -yaa is a feminine suffix, making Jananiyaa a female name. In Hindu mythology, Jananiyaa is considered to be the mother of the universe, nurturing and caring for all living beings.
